---
description: Break an approved design into executable vertical TDD tasks.
agent: implementation-planner
---

# Plan

## Inputs

Feature, design, ADRs, acceptance criteria, repository conventions and tests.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`, confirm the active lifecycle state and authority, inspect only relevant canonical artifacts, and make no assumption that is not supported by evidence or an explicit decision.

## Required output

Ordered tasks with exact paths, RED/GREEN commands, expected outputs, dependencies, risks, and commit boundaries.

Include artifact paths, traceability links, risks, evidence, owner, and recommended next lifecycle state.

## Stop conditions

Stop if any task is vague, untestable, too broad, or depends on an unresolved design choice.
